body:
# Independent audit: affine KKT row and root-to-volume obstruction


`candidate 374134af8a3f1b92`.


The KKT supporting equality at every destination, together with
convexity and the global supporting inequality, forces equality of
the threshold with its affine support on their convex hull. Positive
destination heights give a positive minimum of that affine function
on the compact hull. Hence the anchored projective map is invertible
there, with the displayed inverse and positive denominator. Direct
substitution of that inverse into the original cap inequality gives
exactly coefficient b-((b.p-c)/h_p)a and constant (b.p-c)/h_p.
The sign is correct. Convexity is preserved by positive denominator
reweighting. Fiber q-volume scales by h(z)^(-q), without any claim
that the integer lattice or ambient volume is preserved.

The transformed weights eta_j=theta_j h_j/h_p sum to one and have
base barycenter zero. Dividing the original intrinsic BM root
inequality by h_p gives exactly sum eta_j r_j<=1. Positive target
residual volumes are explicitly assumed; incompatible q-direction
spaces would give dimension greater than q in the actual integer
source, so the use of intrinsic BM is valid. Conversion back gives
the factor h_p eta_j h_j^(q-1) r_j^q exactly. It does not remove the
power of the residual roots. No Jensen inequality has the opposite
of its correct direction.

The example is an actual full body with complete base {-1,0,1}.
The simplex T has determinant q!, hence q-volume one, and the
height cut of 2T at r in (0,2) has volume r^q. The three stated
closed caps cover even the real body: the smaller of their two
upper thresholds is at most the lower cap's threshold 1. All
three traces are proper at all sampled fibers when 0<a<1.
Their residual roots have pointwise minimum (1-a,1,1-a), because
(2^q-1)^(1/q)>1 for q>=2.

Any convex sampled majorant has h_0>=1 and h_-1+h_1>=2h_0.
Strict convexity of the qth power therefore gives objective at
least 3h_0^q>=3, with equality only at h=(1,1,1). This proves
the exact attained optimum and uniqueness. The displayed mu,
lambda, and pi have the stated row means, marginals, flow signs,
and complementary equalities. In particular the single source
row sends equal normalized mass to all three bases, including
the noncontact endpoints, on the same positive affine face.

For the source-active residual H_+, the destination roots are
(1-a,1,1+a), whose average is exactly one. Their qth-power
average is strictly greater than one by strict convexity, giving
precisely Delta_q(a)/3. Subtracting from the common fiber volume
2^q gives the claimed strict deficit in transported captured
volume, and summing gives both global cap masses. The rational
q=2,a=1/2 values 7/6,17/6,17/2,M=12,R=3 all check exactly.

Thus positive affine-face transport and exact root BM equality
do not imply the proposed uncorrected volume charge. Original
fiber BM slack is identically zero in this example. The source
does not claim the caps are a critical deepest-point cover, or
that the example meets a below-target hypothesis, and neither
stronger obstruction follows from the calculation. No correction
was needed.
